quotes.text: j7 ¿Por qué razón no buscó un empleo o no ha hecho preparativos para iniciar o reanudar una actividad por cuenta propia durante las últimas cuatro semanas?
3 Por responsabilidades familiares permanentes (cuidado de niños o personas dependientes)

assessments.reasoning: The supplied survey instrument does not contain a separate module dedicated to domestic or care work. Unpaid care work is only mentioned as a reason for not seeking work or being inactive, as seen in question j7 option 3 ('Por responsabilidades familiares permanentes (cuidado de niños o personas dependientes)'). Consequently, the instrument does not include a separate domestic or care work module, and care work is treated as a category of inactivity or reason for not searching for employment.
